title: Cajun Chicken Rice Bowl
seoTitle: Cajun Chicken Rice Bowl | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Blackened chicken thighs over rice with bell pepper and creole spices
subtitle: Blackened chicken thighs over rice with bell pepper and creole spices
description: Cajun-spiced chicken thighs grill or sear until blackened, served over rice with sautéed trinity peppers and a light creole sauce.

steps.title: Gather ingredients and equipment
steps.instruction: Line up every ingredient for Cajun Chicken Rice Bowl in the order you will cook — measure spices into ramekins, trim proteins on a dedicated board, and set tongs, thermometers, and hotel pans within arm's reach before any heat goes on.

steps.title: Preheat ovens and surfaces
steps.instruction: Preheat ovens, griddles, or grills to recipe temp before the crew arrives — cold equipment extends cook time and dries out batch chicken. Confirm burners ignite evenly and sheet pans are greased or lined.

steps.title: Mix Cajun spice blend
steps.instruction: Combine paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, thyme, cayenne, 1 tbsp salt, and 1 tsp pepper until evenly blended and deeply red in color.

steps.title: Cook rice
steps.instruction: Simmer rice in salted water or broth until fluffy grains separate easily with a fork, not sticky, gummy, or wet at the bottom. Maintain a steady simmer — bubbles should break the surface without a rolling boil that shreds delicate proteins. Plan about 20 minutes for this step at crew scale. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Sauté trinity vegetables
steps.instruction: Cook onion, bell peppers, and celery in oil over medium 8 minutes until softened and edges lightly caramelized with sweet aroma. Keep finished cold items below 41°F if they sit more than 30 minutes — nest the hotel pan on ice at the line. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Blacken chicken
steps.instruction: Coat thighs generously with Cajun blend. Sear in hot oiled skillet 5–6 minutes per side until dark crust forms and internal temp hits 165°F.

steps.title: Verify safe internal temps
steps.instruction: Spot-check the thickest pieces with an instant-read thermometer — target 165°F. If any piece reads low, return it to heat immediately rather than holding under temp on the line.

steps.title: Build bowls
steps.instruction: Slice chicken, portion over rice with sautéed trinity. Deglaze pan with broth for light sauce drizzle. Chicken should be juicy inside, charred outside.

proTips: Reduce cayenne for mild crews—offer Louisiana hot sauce at the line.
Cast iron delivers best blackening crust on flat-top or range.
Andouille sausage slices optional for extra smoky depth.
leftovers: Cajun chicken salad over romaine with ranch.
Slice into wraps with remoulade-style mayo.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Big flavor wake-up after bland meal weeks. Bowl format handles mixed spice tolerances with hot sauce at the line.
mealPrepNotes: Mix Cajun spice in bulk jar. Cook rice while chicken sears. Station: Vent hood on—blackening creates smoke at high heat. Station: Sear chicken in batches for proper crust, not steamed gray meat. Station: Bowl line: rice, chicken, peppers, sauce drizzle, green onion.
